laptop.verified: Served the Blue/Red lobby, arena asset and JPEG from the extracted release. Synthetic camera rendered six floor tags, both bodies and the ball. The ready installation passed pip check.

pi_extracted.scope: Separate ARM64 Ubuntu ROS Jazzy container with no checkout mount, network or devices. Target Pi is Debian. Hailo and target deployment require the physical platform.
pi_extracted.prepare_method: Real Prepare subprocess twice against this staged release and its compiled overlay using a temporary platform template and the approved archived HEF. Built the Home ROS launch description without executing it. No torque, camera process, gamepad or homing.

regressions.extended_result: A loopback regression had assumed the most recently sent camera sequence was already admitted. After replaying the exact admitted source frame and waiting for revocation, 30 isolated repeats and the complete 269-test invocation passed. Suites overlap.

Lifecycle invoked by the fixture. Walk observation sampled after fade; this checks policy input and kick entry, not full clip completion or physical motion.

previous_5_2.observation: Both Python wrappers caught subprocess.TimeoutExpired and retained no partial output or final provider result. An earlier successful review reported 79.320 s elapsed with this model. The upstream cause of the two timeouts is unknown.

previous_5_2.packaging_scope: Archive reproducibility, extracted laptop launcher and clean Pi staging

sensor_findings: The reviewer accepted per-report publication, independent 100 ms receipt expiry and the supported recovery evidence. Physical trip latency, actuator response and fall behavior remain unmeasured.

We traced the proposed unconditional cache invalidation through the hardware read, activation and homing paths. The driver checks receipt age independently from validity. A poll between healthy reports can return a valid, still-fresh cache. Duplicate polls retain the original receipt and cannot renew authority. The legacy timestamp is diagnostic only. Existing cache and dropout regressions exercise expiry. We retained the tested behavior.

The reviewer proposed a supported, instrumented single-stream dropout during hardware qualification. The offline 103–104 ms trips depended on the fixture polling cadence and do not set a measured bound for the Pi.
package_findings: The reviewer accepted the archive checks, clean Mac install and independent Ubuntu/Jazzy staging. The Debian Pi build, hardware enrollment and time to physical motion remain open.

After review, direct byte comparison again found the shipped ZIP, tarball and checksum file identical to the independent clean-clone rebuild. Both ZIP and tarball hashes are recorded above. Prepare timings measure a motor-inactive subprocess. Cold laptop timing measures HTTP availability and includes a separate observation during concurrent compilation.

The reviewer requested an executed rollback receipt. The shipped CLI restored the previous profile, native-prefix selection and release manifest. Its verifier checked all 79 staged files. It disabled a first managed install while retaining its saved profile. Each operation was repeatable.

rollback_check.environment: Isolated ARM64 Ubuntu/Jazzy, network disabled, exact Pi archive and fixture script mounted read-only, no checkout or device. Previous and current platform selections/native files were fixtures, and Avahi/sudo was unavailable. Each staged manifest was verified with the shipped verify CLI.
